description:
Decode label-reference assertion configuration into a typed form when rules load.

## Background

Graph assertions `LabelCoverage`, `LabelReference` and `DependencyShape` hold raw `toml::value::Table` payloads (`crates/jit/src/declarations/rules.rs:577-590,923-927`), and evaluation reads their keys on each call, so a malformed rule surfaces only during evaluation. Typed `Raw*` structs lowered at load are the existing pattern (`rules.rs:940-1089`), and `RuleConfigError::InvalidAssertion` names the rule. Rule serialization renders the tables with `render_config_table` (`repository_state/rule_serialize.rs:267-275,366-396`). Label-reference keys are read in `validation/graph.rs`, and `test_label_reference_missing_key_is_config_error` (`graph.rs:3042`) reaches evaluation with a malformed table.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `LabelReference` holds a typed configuration, with its reference scope as an enum, and no raw table.
- [hard] REQ-02: A malformed label-reference assertion fails rule loading with an error naming the rule, and the evaluation-time error path is gone.
- [hard] REQ-03: Rule serialization emits the same keys for a typed label-reference assertion.
title: Label-reference assertions are typed at load
